#!/sbin/openrc-run
name="inventory-worker"
description="Sandboxed inventory background worker"
pidfile="/run/inventory-worker.pid"
sandbox="/var/lib/inventory"

depend() {
  need localmount
  after bootmisc
}

start() {
  checkpath --directory --owner inventory:inventory --mode 0750 "$sandbox/data"
  ebegin "Starting $name"
  start-stop-daemon --start --background --make-pidfile \
    --pidfile "$pidfile" \
    --chroot "$sandbox" \
    --user inventory:inventory \
    --no-new-privs \
    --exec /bin/busybox -- sh /worker.sh
  eend $?
}

stop() {
  ebegin "Stopping $name"
  start-stop-daemon --stop --retry TERM/5/KILL/5 --pidfile "$pidfile"
  local rc=$?
  rm -f "$pidfile"
  eend "$rc"
}

#!/sbin/openrc-run
name="inventory-worker"

depend() {

  after bootmisc
}

start() {
  checkpath --directory --owner inventory:inventory --mode 0750 "$sandbox/data"
  checkpath --directory --owner inventory:inventory --mode 0755 "$sandbox/run"
  ebegin "Starting $name"
  start-stop-daemon --start --background --make-pidfile \
    --pidfile "$inner_pidfile" \
    --chroot "$sandbox" \
    --user inventory:inventory \
    --no-new-privs \
    --exec /bin/busybox -- sh /worker.sh
  eend $?
}

    local worker_pid
    worker_pid=$(cat "$pidfile")
    if kill -0 "$worker_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      einfo "status: started (pid $worker_pid)"
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  eerror "status: stopped"
  return 3
}

stop() {
  ebegin "Stopping $name"
  start-stop-daemon --stop --retry TERM/5/KILL/5 --pidfile "$pidfile"
  local rc=$?
  rm -f "$pidfile"
  eend "$rc"
}
